summary: The StudentEOrientation system manages the user's electronic orientation process, including course completion and certificate generation. It allows users to retake courses and view certificates.
purpose: To manage electronic orientation for students including course enrollment, completion, retakes, and certificate generation.

workflows.name: Retake Course
steps: Button btnRetake becomes visible if course is completed, allowed to retake, and PRD date is not ended.
User clicks retake, confirmation prompt appears.
If confirmed, the retake script is executed.

workflows.name: Print Certificate
steps: Report HTML is generated if course is completed.

business_rules: Certificate can only be printed if course is completed.
Retake available only if course is completed and PRD date is valid.
Panel visibility based on user session and course completion.
validations: User session must be active for course selection.
Ensure PRDEndDate is valid before allowing retake.
conditions: Check if user is a system administrator or authorized student.
Check if course status is completed.
system_behavior: Shows warning if mandatory course has never been accessed.
Sets CSS class based on course status and due date.
exceptions: Cancels operation if user session is null.
Hides panel if user view is switched.
